description: A React custom hook (`useProjectCostHistorySum`) for fetching and formatting the summed project cost. It communicates with backend API endpoints to retrieve project cost data, utilizing React hooks for state management, memoization, and side effects.

methods.name: useProjectCostHistorySum(projectId, options = {})
methods.description: A React hook that fetches the total project cost, preferring a summarized historical delta cost from the API, with a fallback to the legacy total cost endpoint. Returns cost data, formatted cost string, loading state, error message, and a refetch function.
